name: technical-publisher
description: A technical-writing agent team: an orchestrator coordinates a writer, up to six parallel review axes, an editor, and an optional pandoc export step in a bounded generate-review-revise loop that produces a single polished technical draft and, on request, a .docx/.pdf/.html deliverable. Enforces ASD-STE100 (Simplified Technical English), tested-examples, inclusive-language, and terminology-consistency.
